'''Ardus Industries''' was a chemical company that was based on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The company developed a chemical weapon known as [[smokescreen]], but the Empire seized smokescreen when they captured Ardus's factories.
